rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an invention or the act of inventing.

example.english: This invention has really helped many people.
example.traditional: 呢個發明真係幫到好多人。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 faat3 ming4 zan1 hai6 bong1 dou2 hou2 do1 jan4

rows.note: Use this for the creative capacity or ingenuity behind an invention rather than the invented thing itself.

example.english: The creativity behind their invention is amazing.
example.traditional: 佢個發明背後嘅創意好犀利。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 faat3 ming4 bui3 hau6 ge3 cong3 ji3 hou2 sai1 lei6
